multiple hypotheses with candidate-specific discrimination tests and outcomes are reported Distinguish chemically different hypotheses from repeated guesses for the same direct IRC. State what evidence discriminates each hypothesis; one calculation may support multiple explicitly justified comparisons, but one direct IRC alone does not exclude all untested stepwise paths.

rules.applicability: Evaluate each obtained required observable against this rule. A missing or failed required observable receives no scientific-result credit; truthful partial or failed submissions remain valid and may receive credit for other completed work.
